item.title: Hakkaisan Brewery & Sake Museum: Snow-Aged Sake at the Foot of a Sacred Mountain — Guide
item.description: Hakkaisan, named for the sacred Mount Hakkai it sits beneath, is one of Niigata’s most internationally recognised sake brands, its exceptional quality attributed to pure mountain water, meticulous brewing craftsmanship and a unique snow-aging facility where sake is stored in a naturally insulated chamber packed with compressed snow year-round. The brewery complex includes a museum explaining the sake-making process, a tasting area, and picturesque grounds set against the dramatic backdrop of Mount Hakkai.
